title: trackerEgressPolicy
responsibility: Build the opt-in default-deny egress allowlist for Tracker-launched sessions and render it as Codex and Claude launch arguments.

inputs.name: trackerEgressPolicy.input
inputs.description: Tracker callback hosts (DNS names or exact tailnet addresses) and optional project staging and preprod hosts.

inputs.name: codexEgressArguments.policy
inputs.description: The validated allowlist to render as a Codex permission profile.

inputs.name: claudeEgressArguments.policy
inputs.description: The validated allowlist to render as Claude sandbox settings.

inputs.name: trackerEgressArguments.provider
inputs.description: Which provider CLI the arguments are for.

outputs.name: TRACKER_EGRESS_BASELINE_HOSTS
outputs.description: Exact hosts every pilot session may reach: GitHub, npm, Cloudflare, Twilio, Stripe, Google, OpenAI and Anthropic.

outputs.name: codexEgressArguments
outputs.description: Codex flags: a proxy-gated workspace-write permission profile with approvals never asked.

outputs.name: claudeEgressArguments
outputs.description: Claude flags: sandboxed Bash with an exact domain list, strict MCP config and web tools disallowed.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: A host is a wildcard, URL, port, single label or disallowed address, or no Tracker host was given.
